1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.

2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.207 of 2022, under Section 342, 376 IPC, P.S.
Asandara, District Barabanki.
3.

In terms of the FIR registered on 30.05.2022 it was alleged that on 28.09.2021, the applicant had taken the victim to Rishikesh on the pretext of getting a job at Rs.15,000/- per month and therefore,
it was alleged that a rape was committed on her and was continuously committing.

Subsequently,
she could manage to run away from the said place and on 12.05.2022, she presented an application Dharmendra Yadav vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

1 for registering of an FIR.
Subsequently, during her examination in the Court below, she stated that for the last five months, the applicant took care of her monetary needs and she used to treat him as a brother.
She also stated that she did not marry the applicant and also stated that she did not get the salary as was promised to her.

4. In view of the statement and the allegations in the FIR, particularly the delay, the submission of counsel for the applicant is that the applicant has been falsely implicated and should be enlarged on bail as he has no criminal antecedents.
5. Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.

6. Considering the inordinate delay in lodging the FIR and the subsequent statement of PW 1 as has been filed alongwith the supplementary affidavit coupled with the fact that there is no evidence to corroborate the allegation, a case for bail is made out, as such, the applicant who is in custody since 25.07.2022 and has no criminal antecedent is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
In view thereof, the application is allowed.

7. Let the applicant Dharmendra Yadav be released on bail in aforesaid FIR number on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 17.1.2024 nishant  Dharmendra Yadav vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.
